SELF_HOST_SETUP_TOKEN.description: A unique owner setup secret with at least 24 characters. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A different random secret used to encrypt provider credentials in D1. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

scripts.deploy:hosted: npm run db:migrations:apply:hosted && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.hosted.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:apply:hosted: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.hosted.jsonc
